cohort: Seven post-partum patients diagnosed with acute colonic pseudo-obstruction following deliveries at Christchurch Women's Hospital between 2012 and 2014.
finding: Acute colonic pseudo-obstruction occurs in post-partum patients more frequently than suspected (one in 1500 deliveries) and requires active management including timely administration of neostigmine or endoscopic decompression to reduce complications and surgical intervention.
